Exercise positive own-report write and safe negative foreign-marker/out-of-scope write against disposable target; require actual hook-denial output and unchanged file hashes.
Inspect and trust only exact reviewed hook definitions for disposable target if host requires it; do not alter global approvals or sandbox.
